shape: one queue row, from which a page of a thousand is derived
evidence: GET /specimens answers summary rows and a cursor, never a total, and blanks available_actions on every row (design/08-verification-report.md, criterion 7.3). A thousand rows is the shape a collection reaches after a few drawers, well past the fifty row page the client asks for, so the queue is measured on what a reviewer scrolls rather than on one page.
derivation: The test stamps specimen_id, revision, disposition, stage, blocker and reason_codes per index, so the thousand rows carry every disposition the wire has, including the null one.
